Release Date: In February 2011, directly after Nostalgia, ULTRA, Ocean began writing new songs with Malay, a producer and songwriter who then assisted him with recording channel ORANGE at EastWest Studios in Hollywood. Rather than rely on samples as he had with his mixtape, Ocean wanted to approach sound and song structure differently on the album. channel ORANGE is the debut studio album by Ocean. It was released on July 10, 2012, by Def Jam Recordings. The lyrics on the album eventually led to Ocean coming out as gay on his Tumblr page in 2012.

This would be the last of Blonded Radio until the rollout of Frank's next project.

Release Date: "Look At Us, We're In Love" was an unreleased, house-and-techno-inspired Frank Ocean project. Rather than a traditional album, it was designed as a series of singles for listeners to playlist, with several tracks dropping between 2019 and 2020. The project was shelved in 2020 due to the pandemic (which canceled his tour) and the tragic death of his brother, Ryan Breaux. However, recent promotional posters hint that Ocean is interested in making albums again.
